name: 19121 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19121 (Philadelphia) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19121 (Philadelphia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19121 (Philadelphia) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
